sentences.en: Provided you have a reservation, you can check in anytime.
sentences.zh: 如果你有保留意见，随时都可以办理入住。

sentences.en: I'd like to make a reservation to play golf tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 我想预订明天打高尔夫。

sentences.en: It is necessary that we make a reservation in advance.

senses.zh: 保留的座位[住处]等; 预订 - 保留意见; 保留态度 - (美洲印第安部落的)居留地
